raw_comment: I see that there is a lot of droughts throughout the nation, and I wonder why this is. There are some areas with lots of drought, and others with little to no drought. There are probably many different reasons that contribute to this, and I assume that a large part was due to humans. I experienced, in my area, not much rain for about month and was pretty dry. After that time, we did get rain for a day or 2, but it was somewhat light rain. I hope we don't get a big drought that lasts a long time since that would probably cause many issues.
